claims.claim: Durable wake state distinguishes pending, deferred, ambiguous, submitted and resolved outcomes; v1 migration preserves SUBMITTED dedupe and holds ATTEMPTING without resend.
Fresh and deferred sends check exact canonical identity and current binding before insertion and Send; exact successors resolve without sending, while unknown identities remain held.
Ambiguous attempts never automatically resend and reconcile through bounded outbound-user-turn proof on their original generation or exact canonical resolution.
The Human-owned registry enforces unique chat and state ownership, with per-lane locks, durable inboxes and generation-safe bindings; synthetic regression cases cover lane isolation.
Each lane holds one flight, retains distinct queued subjects, revalidates before sending and compacts only freshly resolved records into permanent duplicate-suppression digests.
The scheduled workflow performs bounded gated drains of previously admitted local work using contents-read permissions without dispatch or ChatGPT Work authority.
Existing H4A3 browser guards and regression cases remain, and intake remains terminal RESULT or FAILURE without assistant-output parsing or semantic lifecycle routing.
The committed changes contain only the five authorized files; the conformance document defines all required bounded Human live proofs without claiming they passed.
